messages:
Anne Porter: Quick heads-up — docs-scan-bot flagged several broken links on /kb/model-onboarding. Anyone own this page? https://kb.redwood.ai/model-onboarding

docs-scan-bot: Automated LinkScan result for /kb/model-onboarding — 5 broken items detected (anchors + s3 image URLs). Sample:
```
/best-practices#kv-cache -> 404
https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-docs/img/onboarding/diagram.png -> 403
/summary#compatibility -> dead anchor
https://old-cdn.redwood.ai/models/model-card.json -> 404
/assets/docs/model-onboarding.pdf -> 404
```

Priya Shah: cc @Kevin Liu — I edited the onboarding flow in the last docs sweep, but didn't touch the diagrams. :eyes:

Kevin Liu: I can claim ownership for a quick fix. Are these failing on staging or prod?

Anne Porter: Prod — a customer hit the page and reported missing images. Can you open a small PR to replace the S3 links with the canonical CDN shortlinks and re-host the diagram? Also add a redirect for the dead anchors if possible.

Kevin Liu: On it. I'll branch off `docs/fix/model-onboarding-links` and include a redirect block in the frontmatter. ETA ~30m. Will also add a smoke test.

Maya Gomez: Heads-up — the diagram also lacks alt text and caption. I'll add alt text in the same PR so accessibility is covered.

Priya Shah: :thumbsup: Happy to review once CI passes. If you need a quick release after merge, I can help with a staged deploy.

Kevin Liu: Adding a tiny link-smoke test to the docs-e2e job that visits the page and asserts 200 on assets. Will ping with PR link when ready (probably PR #3897).

Anne Porter: Thanks team. After merge, can we ask docs-scan-bot to re-run and post results here? I want confirmation anchors and images are resolved before closing the ticket.

docs-scan-bot: Will re-scan after PR merge and post a follow-up. If 0 failures, will auto-close the linked issue in ~24h.
